name: nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers
description: Bulk version of nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser. Recalculates run-count statistics for all hashers whose HasherEventMap records have been modified since @updatedSince. A 1-minute lookback is automatically applied to guard against sub-second race conditions. NULL @updatedSince triggers a full recalculation for all users. Exits immediately if no affected users are found. Writes a summary entry to LOG.GeneralLog on completion. Executes the same 5-stage pipeline as the single-user variant but scoped to a #affected temp table of user IDs, eliminating 3 repeated HEM scans and the O(N²) correlated EXISTS in the HKM summary step from HC5.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Process HEM rows modified after this datetime (with an automatic 1-minute lookback applied). NULL = process all users (full recalculation across all HasherEventMap rows). Default NULL. Note: compared against HC.HasherEventMap.updatedAt which is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — implicit conversion from DATETIME is applied.

sideEffects: Stage 1: May INSERT rows into HC.HasherKennelMap for affected users who have attended a kennel without an existing HKM row.

Stage 2: UPDATEs HC.HasherEventMap count columns (TotalRuns, TotalHaring, TotalRunsThisKennel, TotalHaringThisKennel, YtdTotalRunsThisKennel, YtdHaringThisKennel, updatedAt) for affected users' attended events where counts have changed.
Stage 3: NULLs out the same six HEM count columns for all non-attending (AttendenceState < 20) HEM rows across ALL users (not scoped to #affected — see code smell).

Stage 4: UPDATEs HC.HasherKennelMap summary counters (HcTotalRunCount, HcHaringCount, YtdTotalRunCount, YtdHaringCount, DateOfLastRun, and zeros CurrentHaringCount/CurrentPackRunCount/HistoricalPackRunCount, updatedAt) for affected users' kennel memberships.
Stage 5: UPDATEs HC.HasherKennelMap.RollingYearTotalRunCount, RollingYearHaringCount, updatedAt for affected users.
Inserts 1 row into LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource='RUN COUNTS', Message='Updated all user run counts') after completion.

codeSmells.issue: Stage 3 clears non-attending HEM rows for ALL users, not just #affected
codeSmells.detail: The Stage 3 UPDATE WHERE hem.AttendenceState < 20 AND (counts IS NOT NULL) has no JOIN to #affected. It touches every non-attending HEM row across the entire table that has stale counts — not just the rows for users in #affected. This is semantically correct (clears any stale non-attending counts) but means a large unscoped UPDATE runs on every call, potentially touching many rows unrelated to the current recalculation batch.

HC.HasherEventMap.updatedAt is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) but @updatedSince is typed as DATETIME. SQL Server performs an implicit DATETIME→DATETIMEOFFSET conversion using the server's local timezone. If the server is not UTC, the effective lookback window shifts by the UTC offset. The 1-minute lookback guard partially mitigates small drift but not multi-hour offsets.

codeSmells.issue: Stage 4 unconditionally zeros CurrentHaringCount, CurrentPackRunCount, HistoricalPackRunCount
codeSmells.detail: Same issue as in nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser: these three columns are zeroed on every execution. They appear to be deprecated columns whose correct values are not computed here.

codeSmells.issue: Rolling-year window is ~182 days (6 months), not 365 days
codeSmells.detail: Bucket calculation uses 182-day windows despite the 'rolling year' naming. Consistent with HC5 but misleading in the SP name and comments.

breakingChanges: HC5.fn_GetRunCounts and HC5.fn_GetRunCountsRolling are inlined directly — those legacy scalar functions can now be retired.
Affected users are materialised into a single #affected temp table and JOINed in all stages, eliminating the O(N²) correlated EXISTS anti-pattern from HC5's HKM summary step.
Asymmetric COALESCE sentinels (-999/999) replaced with ISNULL(x, -1) pattern in all change-detection comparisons.
